# Fixture game pack

`semicolon-dodge/` is a hand-written stand-in for a game generated by
`/agentarcade:make`. It exists so the pack loader, the iframe sandbox and the
score path can be exercised without asking an agent to write a game first.

Copy it into agentarcade's games directory to try it:

- Windows: `%APPDATA%\com.sirjan.agentarcade\games\`
- macOS: `~/Library/Application Support/com.sirjan.agentarcade/games/`

The running app picks it up within ten seconds. Delete it again from the Games
tab in settings.

It is also a known-good example: if a real generation misbehaves, diff it
against this one — the differences are usually an external `<script src>`, a
missing freeze handler, or a score that counts seconds rather than play.
